## 41:1 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-he-brought-me to the-nave and-measured the-doorposts — six cubits wide on-each-side — the-width-of the-tent. |
| LOGOS | Then he brought me to the nave and measured the jambs. On each side they were six cubits wide. |
| PNEUMA | Then the man brought me into the main hall of the Temple and measured the doorposts — each one was ten and a half feet wide. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
